endorsements.quote: Important decisions related to students and their illnesses must be made by professional psychiatrists or approved before taking effect.
First, it is necessary to develop relevant usage manuals, accountability rules[ 40 ], and legal regulations.

unlisted_practices: Develop usage manuals and legal regulations governing the use of large multimodal models in student mental health.
Keep models up to date with the latest algorithm advancements.
Update and supplement models with mental health-related data from different countries and organizations while respecting intellectual property protection.
Add a user feedback mechanism to capture and correct user-reported errors, doubtful responses, and inappropriate response language, and use it to improve models.

screen.reason: This is an editorial discussing the potential and governance/safety challenges (hallucinations, ethics, usage manuals) of large multimodal models in student psychiatry.
